findings.summary: Plan lineage re-adds an undeclared citations/rationale key to a plan step's arguments (LineageRef path carries model text) in every mode; the kernel's KERNEL-PLAN-LINEAGE check is what keeps the store clean today.
The end-to-end canary test covers only the typed-answer and single-write runs, not plan steps or grounded.answer.v1, and does not search logs.
